title: entity
description:
One pseudonymous shared identifier.

Identifiers reach this table as salted hashes and the raw values are never stored. The `_HASH` suffixes in entity_type are that design, not a naming habit. identifier_display holds a masked form for an interface to show, which is why it may exist alongside the hash.

identifier_hash.description: Lowercase hex, 32 to 128 characters. A value that is not a hash is refused: accepting one would put a raw phone number into the column every downstream consumer treats as safe.

identifier_display.description: A masked, non-reversible label for display, such as '+91-****-****1234'. Optional, and never reconstructible.

metadata_json.description: Free-form synthetic context. Sanitised on ingestion: keys that look like secrets, tokens, raw identifiers, ground-truth labels, scenario ids or ring ids are dropped rather than stored.
